title: Salem: private candidates must collect old 10th / 12th mark sheets by 15 December 2026
issued_by: District Collector, Salem (press release from the District Public Relations Office, Salem)
says: Private candidates who wrote the higher secondary (12th) or 10th standard exams in Salem district from 2019 to 2023 and have not collected their mark sheets should collect them by 15 December 2026.
what_to_do: Go in person to the Assistant Director of Government Examinations office in Salem with an identity proof and your exam hall ticket, or send a self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 42 postage stamp to that office.
if_not: Mark sheets that are not collected will be treated as waste paper and destroyed, as per exam department rules.
who_it_affects: Private candidates who wrote 10th or 12th standard exams in Salem district between 2019 and 2023 and did not collect their mark sheets.
